owner: Alder Pipes Ltd, an invented company

rules.rule: Write short sentences a plumber would say on site.
Write Alder Pipes as two words, both capitalized.
rules.why: One spelling makes the name easy to find.

rules.rule: Keep a clear space around the logo as wide as the letter A.
rules.why: The logo must read from across a building site.
rules.used_for: Vans, packs and the site header.

rules.rule: Partners write Alder Pipes® the first time the name appears.
rules.why: The trademark must be marked by others.

rules.rule: Use the slogan Pipes for life.

colors.name: Alder green
colors.why: The green of the first van.

colors.name: Sawdust
colors.why: It keeps the green easy to read.

colors.name: Copper
colors.why: The copper of the pipe itself.

typefaces.name: Inter
typefaces.why: It reads well on a phone.

assets.name: Logo, green
assets.why: The logo in the brand color.

claims.claim: Our copper pipes carry a 25 year warranty.
claims.why: Buyers ask how long a pipe lasts.

claims.claim: Every Alder fitting is pressure tested before it leaves the plant.
claims.why: Plumbers fear a joint that fails after the wall is closed.

partner_patterns.fix: Write Alder Pipes® the first time the name appears.

banned_phrases.why: No pipe joint is leak-proof; legal asked us to drop it.
Say what the pipe does: how long it lasts, how fast it fits.
Fine inside the company, odd to a buyer.

legal_lines.line: Alder Pipes is a registered trademark of Alder Pipes Ltd.
